non_claims: This lock records identities a maintainer verified once, at consumption time, against the immutable Gateway origin. Nothing in this repository re-fetches the archive or re-checks the Sigstore certificate on its own.
The release lane binds the downloaded archive by `archive.sha256` alone. `reviewed_signature` is the recorded provenance of that digest, not a signature this repository verifies during a release.

`gateway.tree` and `gateway.protocol_tree` are the producer identities the signed handoff manifest declares. `protocol_tree` is the one this repository can confirm locally, because the vendored copy hashes to it.
